description: This Java interface defines a builder for creating responses and events related to the DeleteFeatureProperties command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested factory interfaces for generating command responses and events, specifically for handling success and error scenarios.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building command responses and events for DeleteFeatureProperties commands.

classes.name: ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command response objects, including success and error responses.

classes.name: EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects triggered by DeleteFeatureProperties commands.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a response indicating successful deletion of feature properties.

methods.name: featurePropertiesNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating feature properties are not accessible.

methods.name: featurePropertiesNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating feature properties are not modifiable.
